title: Generative design of de novo AAV vectors with unique serological profiles
summary: The preprint abstract reports a variational autoencoder trained on natural AAV sequences to generate capsids. More than 255 designs were synthesized and tested in vitro. Seven transduced human cells at over 50% efficiency; four of those avoided neutralization by every AAV-reactive human serum sample tested, at the reported NT50 threshold below 1:50. This establishes in-vitro capsid properties, not in-vivo delivery or clinical efficacy. Review is limited to the abstract and original-server metadata.
ai_technology: Variational autoencoder (generative model of AAV capsid sequences)

evidence.tested: More than 255 AI-generated capsid designs were synthesized and tested in vitro; seven transduced human cells above 50% efficiency and four avoided neutralizing antibodies in all reactive human sera.
evidence.unknown: Review limited to the indexed abstract and publication metadata; full-paper methods and additional limitations were not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: A variational autoencoder learned AAV sequence constraints from natural sequences and generated functional capsid proteins de novo, with a second design campaign exploring uncertain regions.
